svg.title: InnoDB on-call lock-wait relationships
svg.desc: Solid waiter-to-holder arrows show the lock-wait cycle when both explicit SERIALIZABLE transactions have counted two doctors. Both hold shared locks covering Alice and Bob. A requests exclusive access to Alice and waits for B. B requests exclusive access to Bob and waits for A until the enabled detector rejects B's UPDATE with 1213 in the demonstrated schedule. Relevant conflicts only, not a complete index-lock inventory.

g.text: A waits for B's shared lock on Alice
B needs A's shared lock on Bob released
Solid filled arrow: waiter to conflicting lock holder.
S = shared; X = exclusive. Detection enabled.
Here B gets 1213; other schedules can choose differently.
Relevant conflicts only; not the complete lock footprint.
